record.name: Meta Ads
record.one_liner: Meta Ads Marketing API endpoints for creating, managing, and optimizing ad campaigns across Meta technologies.

auth.notes: Every Marketing API call requires an access token (User Access Token, App Access Token, or System User Access Token) passed as a parameter.

access.notes: Developers can register via the developer portal, create an app, and automatically get Limited Access to the Marketing API upon adding the product.

api_surface.notes: Provides Graph API endpoints and the Meta Business SDK for managing ad campaigns, ad sets, creatives, and insights.

mcp.notes: No MCP server or Model Context Protocol is mentioned for the Marketing API (though a separate WhatsApp Business Tools MCP is mentioned elsewhere for messaging).

buildability.reasoning: Self-serve credentials and Marketing API access are automatically available upon registering as a Meta developer, but full production capabilities require going through App Review to upgrade access tiers and permissions.

evidence.claim: The Marketing API is a collection of Graph API endpoints used to help advertise across Meta technologies.
Describes how to register as a Meta developer to access the App Dashboard, APIs, and SDKs.
Every Marketing API call requires an access token as a parameter.
Limited access is automatically granted when adding the Marketing API product, but advanced access requires App Review.
Meta Business SDK supports Java, Node.js, PHP, Python, and Ruby.
